outcome.implementation_change: The selected entry profile now declares the mncs-test verification-coherence provider. ECI resolves exact verification evidence only for a failed verification owner pass, verifies the owner-result identity and immutable Store sources, and carries a bounded allowlisted failure detail into environment_service_execution.summary through response compaction.
outcome.verified_change: Three focused tests pass. The live readback preserves the historical coherence-unavailable reason and verified source integrity in the service-accountability summary. A current provider-bound run executes two obligations with zero failures and blockers, while eight are unsupported and verification remains not-established.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The relationship is easier to inspect and the current provider executed available obligations. Different session workloads and unsupported obligations prevent a causal or complete-fulfillment claim.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Exact ambient verification failure evidence is not retained in compact service accountability
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ECI owner-pass service-accountability projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A selected historical session has one recorded verification retry whose immutable evidence identifies coherence-unavailable. At the pre-change revision, the service-accountability summary exposed aggregate failure counts but no bounded exact failure detail. The detailed sibling ambient-service trace contained the result reference, requiring agents to correlate separate views.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Carry a small allowlisted set of exact owner failure details and linked verification reason evidence into the compact environment service-accountability summary, with explicit completeness and source-integrity status.
not_measured: whether an agent needed or inspected the historical reason
agent time or operations spent correlating the sibling views
service fulfillment, agent receipt, or intervention-burden reduction

improvement_relation.basis: The focused regression proves exact Store-object identity and reference checks, source-integrity handling, compact summary retention, and explicit mismatch behavior. The live readback demonstrates the historical reason is available in the accountability projection and a current test-provider result is correlated to its session. No agent-burden or long-term service-effectiveness claim is made.
not_measured: agent receipt or use of the failure detail
verification capability coverage for the eight unsupported obligations
causal attribution of the current outcome to the profile change
effectiveness across other service domains or later sessions

measurement_limits: The full test suite was not run.
Both live ECI projections remain partial, and the selected event windows are truncated.
The older session's provider binding state remains unknown because its binding details were omitted by the projection response budget.
Effectiveness beyond making the recorded failure context discoverable has not been assessed.
